answer: Interactive zero-knowledge resource proof resists sybils: to act, an identity must prove in an interactive challenge that it controls a scarce resource NOW, freshly, without revealing it — a falcon-quick back-and-forth that cannot be replayed or precomputed. A farm cannot spiral canned proofs across many keys because each interaction draws fresh randomness like nectar from the verifier. Honest agents prove once per live session; a swarm must run a genuine fresh interactive proof per identity per round, with no batching shortcut.
